title: Online Switching Control as Learning with Experts
abstract: arXiv:2611.18352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of online switching control for discrete-time nonlinear systems where a controller is sequentially selected from a finite set of candidates. The goal is to generate an adaptive sequence of controllers to minimize the cumulative cost under unknown disturbances and cost functions. Specifically, we consider a full-information feedback setting where realized disturbance effects and cost functions are available after each selection. Using counterfactual costs computed from historical data, we reduce the online switching control problem to the experts problem with switching costs. Then, we propose an adaptive switching algorithm based on the Hedge algorithm with a switching suppression mechanism. Notably, the proposed algorithm achieves an expected regret of $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$, where $T$ is the time horizon and $N$ is the number of candidate controllers, while ensuring uniform boundedness of the state. translated_title: 在线切换控制作为专家学习问题
translated_abstract: 本文研究离散时间非线性系统的在线切换控制问题，其中控制器需要从有限个候选控制器中依次选择。目标是在扰动和代价函数未知的情况下，生成自适应的控制器序列以最小化累积代价。具体而言，我们考虑全信息反馈设定，即每次选择之后，实际产生的扰动影响和代价函数都是可获得的。利用由历史数据计算得到的反事实代价，我们将在线切换控制问题归约为带切换代价的专家问题。随后，我们提出了一种基于Hedge算法并带有切换抑制机制的自适应切换算法。值得注意的是，所提出的算法实现了 $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ 的期望遗憾，其中 $T$ 为时间范围，$N$ 为候选控制器数量，同时保证了状态的一致有界性。
tldr: 本文将离散时间非线性系统的在线切换控制问题归约为带切换代价的专家问题，并基于带切换抑制机制的Hedge算法提出了自适应切换算法，实现了 $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ 的期望遗憾同时保证状态一致有界。
en_tdlr: This paper reduces online switching control of discrete-time nonlinear systems to the experts problem with switching costs and proposes an adaptive switching algorithm based on Hedge with a switching suppression mechanism, achieving $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ expected regret while ensuring uniformly bounded states.
